### BitGo Brings USDC Minting and Redemption Into Go Accounts


November 12, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/773293151/files/doc_news/BitGo-Brings-USDC-Minting-and-Redemption-Into-Go-Accounts-2026.pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


BitGo Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BTGO) (“BitGo”), the digital asset infrastructure company, today announced the addition of USDC to BitGo Mint. Eligible clients of BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association (“BitGo Bank & Trust”), BitGo’s OCC-regulated digital asset trust bank subsidiary, can now submit orders to mint and redeem USDC directly from their existing Go Account, routed through BitGo's Circle Mint account with flat, predictable, pre-disclosed fees before the order is confirmed.


Establishing a direct relationship with an individual asset issuer can require a separate agreement, onboarding process, account, and ongoing operational resources. For many institutional clients, that overhead isn't justified for a single asset, so teams that want direct mint and redeem access have had to build and maintain it themselves. BitGo brings the mint and redemption process into the account and operational workflows its clients already use.


“The more assets an institution uses, the more work it takes to manage separate accounts and issuer relationships,” said Mike Belshe, CEO and Co-founder of BitGo. “Bringing USDC minting and redempting into the BitGo Go Accounts removes some of that work. We're building on the infrastructure our clients already use so they can access more assets through one BitGo account.”


Clients can initiate and monitor USDC mint and redemption orders through the BitGo platform or API. At launch, the capability supports Ethereum, Solana, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, HyperEVM, Monad, and Aptos.


Onchain components of eligible orders can be processed 24 hours a day, seven days a week, subject to network availability and applicable account controls. Fiat funding and withdrawals remain subject to applicable banking rails, processing windows, and settlement times. Availability may vary based on client eligibility, jurisdiction, acceptance of applicable BitGo Mint terms, supported networks, and other account requirements.


USDC joins USD1 and SoFiUSD among the assets available to eligible clients through BitGo Mint. The platform is designed to aggregate access across issuers so that supported assets can be accessed through a single BitGo account rather than requiring clients to establish and manage a separate operational relationship for each asset.


**About BitGo**


BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit[www.bitgo.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bitgo.com&esheet=54639290&newsitemid=20261110035305&lan=en-US&anchor=www.bitgo.com&index=1&md5=d0380b64afca69e484c1af45872b2bae) .
